# Fixture PDFs

Place the following five Ultimate Guitar Pro PDF files here for v1.2 validation:

| Filename | Layout family |
|---|---|
| `Robben Ford - Revelation - Pro.pdf` | Standard notation |
| `Alannah Myles - Black Velvet - Pro.pdf` | Tab-heavy (single-letter chords) |
| `Larry Carlton - Room 335 - Pro.pdf` | Multi-system |
| `Robben Ford - Aint Got Nothin But The Blues - Pro.pdf` | Multi-system |
| `Charlie Parker - Confirmation - Pro.pdf` | Jazz standard |

Then open `tests/validate.html` in a browser and select each PDF to run acceptance tests.
